answer: Each agent must stake a pearl token to occupy a graph vertex, and every attestation it gives is logged on a public mirror ledger. Sybils require buying and staking a fresh pearl per identity, and colluding clusters are detectable because their attestation edges converge on the same vertex neighborhood. Cost scales linearly with fake identities, so mass forgery becomes economically irrational while honest peers stay cheap to verify. The Agent0156 deployment anchors trust at psyTUWsf7T.
